bs-pro-distribution-ec-config-file-white: Liiska kordhinta faylasha la oggol yahay. Ka tag meel bannaan si aan wax xaddidaad ah u jirin.
bs-pro-distribution-ec-config-domain-whi: Liiska domains-ka la oggol yahay in laga soo dhex geliyo waxyaabaha. Ha ku darin borotokoolka, kaliya ku qor domain-ka. Tusaale ahaan: `github.com`. Ka tag meel bannaan si aan wax xaddidaad ah u jirin.
bs-pro-distribution-ec-config-domain-typ: Domains-ka is-martigeliya waxaa lagu waafajinayaa nooca madasha ay ka tirsan yihiin si loo ogaado URL-yada paste-ka. Ku dar gelitaannada qaabka `domain:type`, tusaale ahaan `gitlab.mycompany.com:gitlab`. Noocyada la taageero: github, gitlab, bitbucket.
